# Harbor Next Agent Notes

Enhanced fork of [goharbor/harbor](https://github.com/goharbor/harbor). Go backend in `src/`, Angular frontend in `src/portal/`, build automation via Taskfile.

## Commands

```bash
task build        # Build Go binaries
task test:quick   # API lint + unit tests
task test:ci      # Full CI pipeline
task images       # Build/push Docker images
task dev:up       # Local dev with hot reload
task apply-patches # Apply branches listed in taskfile/commercial-patches with jj
task release-ready # Verify those patches against a clean clone
```

Go test/build need generated API first: `task build:gen-apis`.

## PRs

- Branch off `main`, never push direct.
- Conventional Commits, capitalized subject: `feat: Add Foo`, `fix: Resolve Bar`, `upstream: Cherry-Pick Harbor Fix`.
- DCO sign-off required: `git commit -s`.
- Squash and merge only; other merge types break release-please.
- No `Co-Authored-By` or AI attribution trailers.
- New features (`feat:`) must add a `## Release Notes` section to the PR description. Its content is extracted and rendered under `## Summary` on the GitHub Release.

## GitHub Actions

- Self-hosted runners are intentionally minimal. When adding a workflow shell command that calls a CLI or interpreter, explicitly install or set up that tool in the same job before using it. Do not assume runner images or JavaScript action runtimes expose tools on `PATH`.
- Pin actions by full commit SHA and keep a version comment, matching the existing workflow style.
- If a workflow calls `node`, add an explicit `actions/setup-node` step first.

## Release-Please

`main` uses `always-bump-minor`; `VERSION` on `main` tracks the next development release while `.release-please-manifest.json` tracks the published release. `release-X.Y` branches use patch-only versioning. `ci:`, `build:`, `chore:`, `test:` are hidden from release notes.

**exclude-paths:** changes touching only `.github/`, `docs/`, `tests/`, or `taskfile/` don't bump version. Use `ci:` for CI-only changes.

## Registry

Default: `8gears.container-registry.com/8gcr/`. Override with `REGISTRY_ADDRESS` / `REGISTRY_PROJECT`. Publishing needs `REGISTRY_USERNAME` / `REGISTRY_PASSWORD` secrets.

# Local Harbor

Minimal local deployment of Harbor. TLS is disabled via `/dev/null` mounts in `.env.example`.

## Prerequisites

- Docker Engine 24+ with Compose v2.24+
- Pre-built Harbor images (`task image:all-images`) or pull from remote registry

## Quick Start (Taskfile)

```bash
task dev:release:up                                                # local images
task dev:release:up IMAGE_REPO=8gears.container-registry.com/8gcr/ # remote images
task dev:release:up TAG=v2.14.0                                    # specific tag
```

Runs in foreground, auto-cleans on Ctrl+C. To stop manually:

```bash
task dev:release:down          # keep data
task dev:release:down:clean    # remove volumes
```

## Manual Start

```bash
cd deploy/compose/example/local
cp .env.example .env
openssl genpkey -algorithm RSA -outform PEM -pkeyopt rsa_keygen_bits:4096 \
  | openssl rsa -traditional -out ../../config/token_service_key.pem
chmod 644 ../../config/token_service_key.pem   # container UID 10000 ≠ host UID → needs world-readable
docker compose -f ../../docker-compose.yaml --env-file .env up -d
```

Open http://localhost and login with `admin` / `Harbor12345`.

## Push / Pull Images

TLS is disabled, so Docker requires the explicit port to use HTTP:

```bash
echo 'Harbor12345' | docker login localhost:80 -u admin --password-stdin
docker tag alpine localhost:80/library/alpine:test
docker push localhost:80/library/alpine:test
docker pull localhost:80/library/alpine:test
```

## Stop

```bash
docker compose -f ../../docker-compose.yaml --env-file .env down        # keep data
docker compose -f ../../docker-compose.yaml --env-file .env down -v     # destroy volumes
```

## Optional: HTTPS with mkcert

For trusted local TLS, install [mkcert](https://github.com/FiloSottile/mkcert) (`brew install mkcert`):

```bash
mkcert -install
mkdir -p certs
mkcert -cert-file certs/tls.crt -key-file certs/tls.key localhost 127.0.0.1 ::1
```

Update `.env`:

```bash
EXT_ENDPOINT=https://localhost
TLS_CONF=../../config/nginx/tls.conf
TLS_CERT=./example/local/certs/tls.crt
TLS_KEY=./example/local/certs/tls.key
```

services:
  portal:
    image: ${IMAGE_REPO:-}harbor-portal:${HARBOR_TAG}
    volumes:
      - ../../config/nginx/proxy.conf:/etc/nginx/proxy.d/proxy.conf:ro
      - ${TLS_CONF:-../../config/nginx/tls.conf}:/etc/nginx/proxy.d/tls.conf:ro
      - ${TLS_CERT:-./config/certs/tls.crt}:/etc/nginx/ssl/tls.crt:ro
      - ${TLS_KEY:-./config/certs/tls.key}:/etc/nginx/ssl/tls.key:ro
    ports:
      - "${PORT_HTTP:-80}:8080"
      - "${PORT_HTTPS:-443}:8443"
    depends_on:
      core:
        condition: service_healthy
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "/lprobe", "-port", "8080"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 3
    restart: unless-stopped

  core:
    image: ${IMAGE_REPO:-}harbor-core:${HARBOR_TAG}
    tmpfs:
      - /tmp:size=256M,mode=1777
    volumes:
      - ./config/token_service_key.pem:/etc/core/token_service_key.pem:ro
    environment:
      # Database
      POSTGRESQL_HOST: postgresql
      POSTGRESQL_PORT: "5432"
      POSTGRESQL_USERNAME: ${DB_USER:-postgres}
      POSTGRESQL_PASSWORD: ${DB_PASSWORD}
      POSTGRESQL_DATABASE: ${DB_NAME:-registry}
      POSTGRESQL_SSLMODE: ${DB_SSLMODE:-disable}
      # Redis — DB indexes follow upstream: core=0, registry=1, jobservice=2, trivy=5
      _REDIS_URL_CORE: redis://${REDIS_HOST:-redis}:${REDIS_PORT:-6379}/0
      _REDIS_URL_REG: redis://${REDIS_HOST:-redis}:${REDIS_PORT:-6379}/1
      # Registry
      REGISTRY_URL: http://registry:5000
      REGISTRY_CONTROLLER_URL: http://registryctl:8080
      REGISTRY_CREDENTIAL_USERNAME: ${REGISTRY_CREDENTIAL_USERNAME:-}
      REGISTRY_CREDENTIAL_PASSWORD: ${REGISTRY_CREDENTIAL_PASSWORD:-}
      # Core
      EXT_ENDPOINT: ${EXT_ENDPOINT}  # Required: public URL (e.g. https://registry.example.com)
      CORE_URL: http://core:8080
      HARBOR_ADMIN_PASSWORD: ${HARBOR_ADMIN_PASSWORD}
      CACHE_ENABLED: ${CACHE_ENABLED:-true}
      LOG_LEVEL: ${LOG_LEVEL:-info}
      TOKEN_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH: /etc/core/token_service_key.pem
      # JobService
      JOBSERVICE_URL: http://jobservice:8888
      CORE_SECRET: ${CORE_SECRET}
      JOBSERVICE_SECRET: ${JOBSERVICE_SECRET}
      # Trivy
      TRIVY_ADAPTER_URL: http://trivy-adapter:8080
      WITH_TRIVY: ${WITH_TRIVY:-true}
      PERMITTED_REGISTRY_TYPES_FOR_PROXY_CACHE: docker-hub,harbor,azure-acr,ali-acr,aws-ecr,google-gcr,docker-registry,github-ghcr,jfrog-artifactory
      REPLICATION_ADAPTER_WHITELIST: ali-acr,aws-ecr,azure-acr,docker-hub,docker-registry,github-ghcr,google-gcr,harbor,huawei-SWR,jfrog-artifactory,tencent-tcr,volcengine-cr
    depends_on:
      postgresql:
        condition: service_healthy
      redis:
        condition: service_healthy
      registry:
        condition: service_healthy
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "/lprobe", "-port", "8080", "-endpoint", "/api/v2.0/ping"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5
      start_period: 30s
    restart: unless-stopped

  jobservice:
    image: ${IMAGE_REPO:-}harbor-jobservice:${HARBOR_TAG}
    tmpfs:
      - /tmp:size=256M,mode=1777
    volumes:
      - ../../config/jobservice.yml:/etc/jobservice/config.yml:ro
    environment:
      POSTGRESQL_HOST: postgresql
      POSTGRESQL_PORT: "5432"
      POSTGRESQL_USERNAME: ${DB_USER:-postgres}
      POSTGRESQL_PASSWORD: ${DB_PASSWORD}
      POSTGRESQL_DATABASE: ${DB_NAME:-registry}
      POSTGRESQL_SSLMODE: ${DB_SSLMODE:-disable}
      REDIS_URL: redis://${REDIS_HOST:-redis}:${REDIS_PORT:-6379}
      CORE_URL: http://core:8080
      CORE_SECRET: ${CORE_SECRET}
      JOBSERVICE_SECRET: ${JOBSERVICE_SECRET}
      REGISTRY_URL: http://registry:5000
      REGISTRY_CONTROLLER_URL: http://registryctl:8080
      REGISTRY_CREDENTIAL_USERNAME: ${REGISTRY_CREDENTIAL_USERNAME:-}
      REGISTRY_CREDENTIAL_PASSWORD: ${REGISTRY_CREDENTIAL_PASSWORD:-}
      TOKEN_SERVICE_URL: http://core:8080/service/token
      LOG_LEVEL: ${LOG_LEVEL:-info}
    depends_on:
      core:
        condition: service_healthy
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "/lprobe", "-port", "8888", "-endpoint", "/api/v1/stats"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5
    restart: unless-stopped

  registryctl:
    image: ${IMAGE_REPO:-}harbor-registryctl:${HARBOR_TAG}
    tmpfs:
      - /tmp:size=256M,mode=1777
    volumes:
      - ../../config/registryctl.yml:/etc/registryctl/config.yml:ro
      - ../../config/registry.yml:/etc/registry/config.yml:ro
      - registry-data:/var/lib/registry
    environment:
      PORT: "8080"
      LOG_LEVEL: ${LOG_LEVEL:-info}
      REGISTRY_CONFIG: /etc/registry/config.yml
      CORE_SECRET: ${CORE_SECRET}
      JOBSERVICE_SECRET: ${JOBSERVICE_SECRET}
    depends_on:

        condition: service_healthy
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "/lprobe", "-port", "8080", "-endpoint", "/api/health"]

      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5
    restart: unless-stopped

  registry:
    image: ${IMAGE_REPO:-}harbor-registry:${HARBOR_TAG}
    volumes:
      - ../../config/registry.yml:/etc/registry/config.yml:ro
      - registry-data:/var/lib/registry
    environment:
      REGISTRY_HTTP_SECRET: ${CORE_SECRET}
      HTTP_PROXY: ${HTTP_PROXY:-}
      HTTPS_PROXY: ${HTTPS_PROXY:-}
      NO_PROXY: ${NO_PROXY:-}
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "/lprobe", "-port", "5001", "-endpoint", "/debug/health"]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 3s
      retries: 5
    restart: unless-stopped

  trivy-adapter:
    image: ${IMAGE_REPO:-}trivy-adapter:${HARBOR_TAG}
    environment:
      SCANNER_LOG_LEVEL: ${LOG_LEVEL:-info}
      SCANNER_REDIS_URL: redis://${REDIS_HOST:-redis}:${REDIS_PORT:-6379}/5
      SCANNER_STORE_REDIS_URL: redis://${REDIS_HOST:-redis}:${REDIS_PORT:-6379}/5
      SCANNER_STORE_REDIS_NAMESPACE: harbor.scanner.trivy:store
      SCANNER_JOB_QUEUE_REDIS_URL: redis://${REDIS_HOST:-redis}:${REDIS_PORT:-6379}/5
      SCANNER_JOB_QUEUE_REDIS_NAMESPACE: harbor.scanner.trivy:job-queue
      SCANNER_TRIVY_CACHE_DIR: /tmp/trivy
      SCANNER_TRIVY_REPORTS_DIR: /tmp/reports
      SCANNER_TRIVY_VULN_TYPE: os,library
      SCANNER_TRIVY_SEVERITY: UNKNOWN,LOW,MEDIUM,HIGH,CRITICAL
      SCANNER_API_SERVER_ADDR: ":8080"
    tmpfs:
      - /tmp:size=2G,mode=1777
    depends_on:
      redis:
        condition: service_healthy
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "/lprobe", "-port", "8080", "-endpoint", "/probe/ready"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5

  exporter:
    image: ${IMAGE_REPO:-}harbor-exporter:${HARBOR_TAG}
    tmpfs:
      - /tmp:size=256M,mode=1777
    environment:
      HARBOR_DATABASE_HOST: postgresql
      HARBOR_DATABASE_PORT: "5432"
      HARBOR_DATABASE_USERNAME: ${DB_USER:-postgres}
      HARBOR_DATABASE_PASSWORD: ${DB_PASSWORD}
      HARBOR_DATABASE_DBNAME: ${DB_NAME:-registry}
      HARBOR_DATABASE_SSLMODE: ${DB_SSLMODE:-disable}
      HARBOR_EXPORTER_METRICS_PATH: /metrics
      HARBOR_EXPORTER_PORT: "8080"
      HARBOR_SERVICE_HOST: core
      HARBOR_SERVICE_PORT: "8080"
      HARBOR_SERVICE_SCHEME: http
      HARBOR_REDIS_URL: redis://${REDIS_HOST:-redis}:${REDIS_PORT:-6379}/2
      HARBOR_REDIS_NAMESPACE: harbor_job_service_namespace
      HARBOR_REDIS_TIMEOUT: "3600"
    depends_on:
      core:
        condition: service_healthy
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "/lprobe", "-port", "8080", "-endpoint", "/metrics"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5
    restart: unless-stopped

  postgresql:
    image: docker.io/library/postgres:${POSTGRES_VERSION:-16}-alpine
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: ${DB_USER:-postgres}
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${DB_PASSWORD}
      POSTGRES_DB: ${DB_NAME:-registry}
    volumes:
      - postgres-data:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "pg_isready", "-U", "${DB_USER:-postgres}"]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 3s
      retries: 5
    restart: unless-stopped

  redis:
    image: valkey/valkey:${VALKEY_VERSION:-8}
    volumes:
      - redis-data:/data
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "valkey-cli", "ping"]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 3s
      retries: 5
    restart: unless-stopped

    desc: Drop database, recreate it, and apply all migrations from scratch

    desc: Open interactive psql session on the dev database
    cmd: '{{.COMPOSE_CMD}} exec postgresql psql -U {{.POSTGRES_USER}} -d {{.POSTGRES_DB}}'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  gen:private-key:local:
    internal: true
    status: ['test -f {{.TOKEN_KEY_FILE_LOCAL}}']
    cmds:
      - mkdir -p $(dirname {{.TOKEN_KEY_FILE_LOCAL}})
      - openssl genpkey -algorithm RSA -outform PEM -pkeyopt rsa_keygen_bits:4096 | openssl rsa -traditional -out {{.TOKEN_KEY_FILE_LOCAL}}
      - chmod 644 {{.TOKEN_KEY_FILE_LOCAL}}

  release:up:
    desc: "Start release images locally (IMAGE_REPO= for remote, empty for local)"
    deps: [require-docker, gen:private-key:local]
    vars:
      TAG: '{{.TAG | default .VERSION}}'
      REPO: '{{.IMAGE_REPO | default ""}}'
    env:
      HARBOR_TAG: '{{.TAG}}'
      IMAGE_REPO: '{{.REPO}}'
    cmds:
      - defer: { task: release:down, vars: { TAG: "{{.TAG}}", IMAGE_REPO: "{{.REPO}}" } }
      - echo "Release {{.TAG}} {{if .REPO}}({{.REPO}}){{else}}(local){{end}} → http://localhost admin/Harbor12345"
      - docker compose -f {{.COMPOSE_LOCAL_FILE}} --env-file {{.COMPOSE_LOCAL_ENV}} up

  release:down:
    desc: Stop release containers
    vars:
      TAG: '{{.TAG | default .VERSION}}'
      REPO: '{{.IMAGE_REPO | default ""}}'
    env:
      HARBOR_TAG: '{{.TAG}}'
      IMAGE_REPO: '{{.REPO}}'
    cmd: docker compose -f {{.COMPOSE_LOCAL_FILE}} --env-file {{.COMPOSE_LOCAL_ENV}} down

  release:down:clean:
    desc: Stop release containers and remove all volumes
    vars:
      TAG: '{{.TAG | default .VERSION}}'
      REPO: '{{.IMAGE_REPO | default ""}}'
    env:
      HARBOR_TAG: '{{.TAG}}'
      IMAGE_REPO: '{{.REPO}}'
    cmd: docker compose -f {{.COMPOSE_LOCAL_FILE}} --env-file {{.COMPOSE_LOCAL_ENV}} down -v

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Utilities
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  clean:
    desc: Remove all containers, volumes, node_modules, and temp files
    cmds:
      - '{{.COMPOSE_CMD}} {{.ALL_PROFILES}} down -v'
